'''Gerrenthum''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].

==History==
It was from Gerrenthum, [[400 BBY/Legends|400]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], that Lord [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] plumbed the depths of the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] and blazed the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] and [[Nothoiin Corridor]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], its fortuitous location at the junction of three important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] led Gerrenthum to grow from a sleepy [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet into a modern megaworld.

It was surrounded by thousands of nav beacons that outlined the corridors off and on the planet, and thousands of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] passed through the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] of Gerrenthum every hour. Gerrenthum was also the headquarters of the various Figg corporations, including [[Figg & Associates]], [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]], and the [[Outer Javin Company]]. Planetary security was tight for members and friends of the [[Figg family]].
